evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run plan for qualifying an Intel enclosure with the combined power and thermal profiling skill. Use BalancedHigh, leave thermal_profile=none, and use a bounded 60s CPU+iGPU stress window. Do not apply settings, start turbostat/stress-ng, or claim a trace exists; show the planned orchestration, safety gates, and report structure.
evals.expected_output: Provide a fail-closed staged plan with one Planned Session table, sub-skill dry-runs, a dry-run confirmation outcome, required report fields, and reverse-order rollback guidance without claiming execution evidence.
expectations: Identifies the orchestrator and sequences power, optional thermal, monitor, bounded stress, and summary stages
Resolves BalancedHigh, thermal_profile=none, and a required bounded duration of 60s
Includes sub-skill dry-runs, one Planned Session table, and a single dry-run confirmation outcome before any mutation
Lists pre-existing stressor/monitor, required tools/scripts, and sudo probe checks for a real run without claiming they passed here
Defines the consolidated PkgTmp/PkgWatt/GFXWatt report, SysWatt annotation, verdicts, and reverse-order rollback
